title: matricaria coronaria
intro: Matricaria coronaria, commonly known as the corn marigold or annual calendula, is an annual flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Matricaria coronaria are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
